caption: The drawing depicts a decorative plate illustrated in two perspectives: a top view and a side profile. The plate is primarily blue with varying shades to indicate highlights and contours. The top view shows a circular plate with a scalloped edge and a decorative pattern. Around the perimeter, there are repeated heart-shaped motifs, while the center features a symmetrical, petal-like geometric design comprised of five pointed segments. The side view, positioned below, reveals the plate’s shallow, gently sloping profile and repeats the heart motif along its outer edge, corresponding with the top-down view. The background is a plain, light beige color with some minor brown stains and marks near the top.
title: Cup Plate
